name: Takei's Journey
source:
The Takei clan had a normal civilian life for centuries, but their historical enemy has finally come to attack and had no mercy to achieve her goals, now after learning what your family hid from you, it's up to the last Takei man to save those who got caught by her evil hands!

But don't worry, there will be some Kunoichis to help and please you while you're saving their dads, husbands, and friends.

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/takeis-journey-v0-9-0-ferrum.82236/]F95zone[/url]]
translation:
武井氏族几个世纪以来一直过着正常的平民生活，但他们的宿敌终于来袭，并且为了达到她的目的而毫不留情，现在在得知你的家人向你隐瞒了什么之后，最后的武井男人必须拯救那些被她邪恶之手抓住的人！

但别担心，当你拯救他们的父亲、丈夫和朋友时，会有一些女忍者来帮助和取悦你。

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/takeis-journey-v0-9-0-ferrum.82236/]F95zone[/url]]
